question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Innocense.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be "**Innocence**"
 
• **Innocence**: The quality or state of being innocent; freedom from sin or moral wrong. (बेगुनाही)
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1, which is incorrectly spelled.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Governance**: The act or process of governing or overseeing the control and direction of something such as a country or a state. (शासन)
 
• **Enforcement**: The act of compelling observance of or compliance with a law, rule, or obligation. (किसी कानून, नियम या दायित्व के पालन या अनुपालन के लिए बाध्य करने का कार्य)
 
• **Insufficient**: Not enough in amount, strength, or quality; less than is needed. (मात्रा, शक्ति या गुणवत्ता में पर्याप्त नहीं; आवश्यकता से कम)
